origin.description: The user explicitly requires architectural choices, rejected options and reasons to survive, and requests useful harness practices be assimilated without flattening Projector into instructions.
Motivating integration evidence; not authority for Projector-specific design or claimed implementation.

payload.statement: For application behavior that needs runtime observation, make the affected scenario executable in an isolated application instance and give the host agent access to the required browser, input, logs, metrics or traces using existing tools. Record setup, teardown, isolation, repository state, scenario, collection method and freshness. Bind acceptance claims to the actual observations and retain diagnostic evidence on failure. Prefer a concrete application adapter over a generic provisioning framework. Pinned repository Node validators provide a current bounded lane; generic browser evidence authentication, service provisioning and telemetry integration remain unrealized until a real adapter demonstrates them. No stored promise or screenshot alone proves fidelity.
payload.title: Connect affected meaning to inspectable application behavior
